name: Istanbul
summary: Start among the monuments of Sultanahmet, then cross the water for neighbourhood food and street life. Keep the historic centre on one day and the Bosphorus or Asian shore on another.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn suit long walks; summer crowds and winter rain can slow sightseeing.
arrival: IST and SAW are different airports; confirm the airport before selecting metro, airport bus or a licensed transfer.
gettingAround: Use an Istanbulkart for city transit and ferries; walk the compact Sultanahmet sights and allow for hills elsewhere.
cashTip: Keep small TRY notes for markets and snacks; cards are common at major sights. Compare the bill before paying.
foodTip: Try simit, lentil soup, fish sandwiches and baklava; order by portion and check menu prices.
buyTip: Look for ceramics, towels and spices; compare several stalls and confirm weight and quality.
baseArea: Sultanahmet for monuments; Karaköy for food and ferries

connections.note: Approximate airborne time; airport transfers, baggage and immigration are additional.

items.name: Galata Tower
items.summary: A medieval stone tower gives a compact overview of Istanbul’s waterways and hills.
items.expect: The observation level helps orient the Golden Horn, old city and Bosphorus in one visit.
items.tip: Check the museum’s official access status before travelling: the official page lists the tower open, while a review-platform page carried a closure label. The observation level is compact and can be crowded.
items.priceNote: Planning allowance in TRY; the official museum page quotes admission in EUR, so the local-currency amount depends on the exchange rate. Recheck the current ticket and included session.

items.name: TURK Fatih Tutak
items.summary: Fatih Tutak’s two-star restaurant reinterprets Turkish regional ingredients and dishes in a long tasting menu.
items.expect: A long tasting-menu meal. Deposits, cancellation fees and smart-casual dress codes are common at this level.
items.tip: Book through the restaurant’s own site or official booking partner as soon as your dates are set.
items.priceNote: Per-person planning estimate from the MICHELIN price band (₺₺₺₺), not a menu quote; drinks, service and tax may add to the total.
items.bestTime: Lunch or dinner by reservation; check the current service days

whyVisit: Fatih Tutak’s two-star restaurant reinterprets Turkish regional ingredients and dishes in a long tasting menu.
The MICHELIN Guide awards it Two MICHELIN Stars (excellent cooking), a rare level of recognition.
visitFlow: Book through the restaurant’s own site or official booking partner as soon as your dates are set.
Share allergies and dietary needs when booking; tasting menus are hard to change on the night.
